user.title: Connect your PianoDisc Prodigy II
user.description: Enter the piano's IP address. Tip: if your piano already publishes MQTT, it can be discovered automatically instead.

discovery_confirm.title: PianoDisc Prodigy II discovered
discovery_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

reconfigure.title: PianoDisc Prodigy II network settings
reconfigure.description: Update the IP address for {name}. This must be the same piano.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the piano at that address. Check the IP and that the piano is powered on.
error.wrong_device: That address answered, but it is a different piano. Enter the IP of this piano.

abort.already_configured: This piano is already set up.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: Discovery message was not recognized as a Prodigy II.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The piano's network settings were updated.

init.title: Power outlet
init.description: Link the outlet or controller that powers this piano so Home Assistant can turn it on and off and show its power state. Only link an outlet dedicated to the piano — Home Assistant cuts its power when you turn the piano off. Leave empty to disable power control.

data_description.power_switch: A switch, smart plug, outlet, or input boolean that controls power to the piano.

play_song.name: Play song
play_song.description: Play a song by name on the piano, optionally setting the volume first and restoring it afterwards.

song.name: Song
song.description: Name of the song to play (matched against the piano's library).

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: Optional volume to set before playing (0–100).

restore_volume_after.name: Restore volume after
restore_volume_after.description: Restore the previous volume once the song has been started.

create_playlist.name: Create playlist
create_playlist.description: Create a playlist on the piano and write the updated playlist set back to the device.

songs.name: Songs
songs.description: Songs or raw /sd paths to include.

excludes.name: Excludes
excludes.description: Songs or raw /sd paths to exclude.

update_playlist.name: Update playlist
update_playlist.description: Update playlist metadata while preserving its songs.

delete_playlist.name: Delete playlist
delete_playlist.description: Delete a playlist from the piano.

add_playlist_song.name: Add playlist song
add_playlist_song.description: Add a song to a playlist include or exclude list.

exclude.name: Exclude
exclude.description: Add to the exclude list instead of the include list.

remove_playlist_song.name: Remove playlist song
remove_playlist_song.description: Remove a song from a playlist include or exclude list.

exclude.name: Exclude
exclude.description: Remove from the exclude list instead of the include list.

song_not_found.message: No song matching '{song}' was found on the piano.

playlist_not_found.message: No playlist matching '{playlist}' was found on the piano.

playlist_already_exists.message: A playlist named '{playlist}' already exists on the piano.

power_on_timeout.message: Powered the outlet but the piano did not come online within {seconds} seconds. Check that the linked switch actually powers this piano.

power_on_timeout.title: Piano did not power on
power_on_timeout.description: Home Assistant switched on the linked outlet ({switch}) but {name} never came online. Check that the linked switch powers this piano and that the piano is connected to the network.
